data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 5 (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause identified via CI log analysis: reconcile.py:423 calls applier.apply(mutations, pass_id, repo_root) passing the full mutations list (which contains both inbound and outbound typed Mutation objects) to the legacy batch path in applier.apply(). The inbound-guard at applier.py:1259-1266 raises TypeError when inbound typed Mutations are detected. Fix: split mutations in reconcile_once into typed (Mutation objects with .direction/.action) and legacy (dicts). Typed mutations are dispatched per-mutation via _dispatch_mutation (already present in reconcile.py). Legacy dicts continue through applier.apply(). This is the fix described in the error message itself: 'Inbound dispatch should route through reconcile._dispatch_mutation / _apply_typed per-mutation.'
